svg.title: Alisha Chaudhary, Cybersecurity Analyst
svg.desc: Animated hero banner with a rotating three-dimensional evidence network. Cybersecurity Analyst focused on IAM and access governance and vulnerability intelligence, based in Hyderabad, India. Evidence first. Understand the system. Make the finding actionable.
